caption: The drawing features three representations of a shoe on a plain background. The central and largest image is a detailed, colored illustration of a brown leather lace-up shoe with a closed heel and a low heel, displaying highlights and shadows to suggest volume. The shoe is shown from a side view with a single thin lace that dangles outward. Above and to the left of this shoe, there are two line drawings; the leftmost is an outline showing the sole of the shoe with several small circular shapes indicating where nails or stitching might be placed, while the adjacent line drawing depicts an overhead view of the shoe with the lace untied and some construction lines indicated. The composition is arranged with the colored shoe in the foreground and the line drawings in the background, all set against a light beige backdrop.
title: Man's Shoe
